mu_name_from: The Dungeon's object slot 39, the model index: type N is Object{N+1}.bmd (MapManager.cpp:1121-1123).
sheet_from: Data/Object2/, from MuMain, decoded under a dn_ prefix.
sheet_materials_from: As the Dungeon's other masonry (flagstone) and its iron fences' wire_netting01 (timber).
why_this_one: The Lance Trap, 27 of them, OpenMU's NPC 100. MuMain hides the placement (HiddenMesh -2, ZzzObject.cpp:3893-3897) and draws the live trap as this same model (ZzzCharacter.cpp:14274-14282), so the game draws it from the realm's trap (game/world/traps.h), not as scenery. It fires a saw blade out along its facing (CreateEffect(MODEL_SAW), ZzzCharacter.cpp:1223-1227).
